Players Committee card image of [[Lord Maul With Lightsaber (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Permanent weapon is •Maul's Lightsaber (may add 1 to Force drain where present; adds 1 to your battle destiny draws here; may target a character for free; draw two destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value).”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/lordmaulwithlightsaber.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a5142dd7418713cff839446994555bb787c156b4 a5142dd] (12 May 2020). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
